target.title: fix(android): default manual TLS port to 18789 except Tailscale hosts
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

When Android manual gateway connect has TLS enabled and the port field is left blank, `composeGatewayManualUrl` always defaulted to port **443**. iOS only uses 443 for Tailscale `.ts.net` hosts; other TLS manual hosts default to **18789** (`GatewayConnectionController.resolveManualPort`, tested by `manualDefaultPortUses443OnlyForTailnetTLSHosts`).

That mismatch caused Android to dial the wrong port for LAN/public TLS gateways (for example `gateway.example.com` with TLS on and an empty port field).

## Why This Change Was Made

Align Android manual empty-port resolution with iOS `shouldForceTLS` / `resolveManualPort` rules:

- `.ts.net` / `.ts.net.` suffix → default **443**
- all other TLS manual hosts → default **18789**

Also update Connect tab port placeholder/label via `resolveManualPortPlaceholder`, which follows the same resolved endpoint as `composeGatewayManualUrl` / `parseGatewayEndpoint` (including pasted `wss://…` URLs that keep scheme default port 443).

## User Impact

Operators connecting to a non-Tailscale TLS gateway with a blank port field now reach `:18789` like iOS instead of incorrectly trying `:443`. Tailscale MagicDNS hosts still default to 443 when the port is omitted.

## Evidence

iOS parity source:

- `apps/ios/Sources/Gateway/GatewayConnectionController.swift` (`shouldForceTLS`, `resolveManualPort`)
- `apps/ios/Tests/GatewayConnectionSecurityTests.swift` (`manualDefaultPortUses443OnlyForTailnetTLSHosts`)

### Unit tests (Windows, Play debug unit test variant)

```powershell
cd apps/android
$env:JAVA_HOME = "F:\Program Files\Android\Android Studio\jbr"
$env:ANDROID_HOME = "F:\Android\Sdk"
.\gradlew.bat :app:testPlayDebugUnitTest --tests "ai.openclaw.app.ui.GatewayConfigResolverTest"
pnpm native:i18n:check
```

Result: **BUILD SUCCESSFUL** (full `GatewayConfigResolverTest` suite) and **`native-app-i18n: entries=2478 changed=false`**.

Key placeholder/resolver cases now covered:

- `composeGatewayManualUrlDefaultsPortTo18789ForNonTailnetTlsHostsWhenPortBlank`
- `composeGatewayManualUrlDefaultsPortTo443WhenTlsAndPortBlank`
- `composeGatewayManualUrlDefaultsPortTo443ForTailnetHostWithTrailingDotWhenPortBlank`
- `shouldForceTlsForGatewayHost_matchesIosTailnetSuffixRules`
- `resolveManualPortPlaceholder_matchesResolvedEndpointForBareAndCompleteUrls` (bare non-tailnet → 18789, tailnet → 443, `wss://gateway.example` → 443)
- `resolveManualPortPlaceholder_usesExplicitPortWhenProvided`

### Android emulator behavior proof

Environment: Android Studio **Medium_Phone** AVD, `:app:installPlayDebug` on Windows.

Verified on device that post-onboarding **Settings → Gateway → Connection Setup** uses the same resolver path (`resolveGatewayConnectPlan` → `composeGatewayManualUrl`). With TLS selected and an empty port:

- `gateway.example.com` resolves to HTTPS `:18789` (non-tailnet TLS default)
- `device.sample.ts.net` resolves to HTTPS `:443` (tailnet suffix default)

Connect tab label/placeholder behavior is driven by `resolveManualPortPlaceholder` (same resolved endpoint as above, including complete pasted URLs).

Changed files:

- `apps/android/app/src/main/java/ai/openclaw/app/ui/GatewayConfigResolver.kt`
- `apps/android/app/src/main/java/ai/openclaw/app/ui/ConnectTabScreen.kt`
- `apps/android/app/src/test/java/ai/openclaw/app/ui/GatewayConfigResolverTest.kt`
- `apps/.i18n/native-source.json`
